pages.text: Only $(bold)crafting-table recipes$() can be locked, so the rule is: the things built $(italic)from$() a material are locked, the material is not. Anyone can mix brass in a basin; nobody without the Blueprint can make a casing or a funnel from it.$(br2)Locked recipes are also locked to $(bold)place$(): a brass machine handed to you will not go down until you have learned it.

$(li)$(bold)Brass:$() every recipe with brass in it or brass out of it, and the mechanical crafter.$(li)$(bold)Blasting:$() everything made with gunpowder, TNT, the empty blaze burner, muskets and cartridges, powder charges.$(li)$(bold)Climate:$() the hearth, boiler and icebox.$(li)$(bold)Cooking:$() Slice & Dice slicer and sprinkler.
pages.title: Tier 1 and 2

pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Trains:$() track, stations, controls, schedules, signals, train doors, railway casing, all of Steam 'n' Rails.$(li)$(bold)Ships:$() the dockyard, ship cannon and shot; airships and their parts.$(li)$(bold)Trading Floor:$() the depot.$(li)$(bold)Diesel:$() all of Create Diesel Generators.$(li)$(bold)Diving:$() Create's backtank, diving helmet and boots; the conduit.

$(li)$(bold)Precision:$() everything made with a precision mechanism: arms, speed controllers, sequenced gearshifts, extendo grips.$(li)$(bold)Netherite:$() ingots and anything crafted from them (smithing is not locked).$(li)$(bold)Cannons:$() Create Big Cannons; the biplane, warship and aircraft guns.
pages.title: Tier 3

pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Arcane:$() Enchantment Industry and Dragons Plus.$(li)$(bold)Ender:$() ender chests, portable interfaces, item vaults, smart chutes, stockpile switches.
pages.title: Tier 4

pages.text: $(bold)Recruiting$() locks the act of hiring, not an item: emeralds on a recruit do nothing until you have learned it. Guards and your own dogs are never locked.$(br2)Hover anything grey in EMI: the tooltip names the Blueprint and the boss that holds it.
